path.dispersion: Single exact zero-Bloch fibre of three periodic nearest-neighbour cycles. T_i=Gamma_i/(2i), forward exp(iqA_i) and adjoint reverse give v sin(qA_i) Gamma_i. Opposite paths cancel at A=0; their derivatives add. Frame-dependent Clifford hopping is an explicit input, not an emergence derivation. Remaining Bloch fibres are not populated or claimed solved.
path.derivative: Hvector(0)=0; J_i=-v q Gamma_i, Kvector_ij(0)=0. The scalar mass grade Z anticommutes every Gamma_i; different currents do not commute.

scope: All one-current-connected H0 blocks. NOT nonlinear finite-A closure, pair yield, spatial continuity, free COM or photon scattering.
